user.title: Viark satellite receiver
user.description: Enter the address of your Viark receiver. It must be powered on or in soft standby; in deep standby it drops off the network entirely.

data_description.host: The receiver's IP address, for example 192.168.1.50.
data_description.port: The control port. Leave at 20000 unless you have changed it.

error.cannot_connect: Could not talk to a Viark receiver at that address. Check the IP, make sure the receiver is not in deep standby, and confirm port 20000 is reachable.

send_key.name: Send key
send_key.description: Inject a remote-control key code into the receiver.

key.name: Key
key.description: A key name (mute, power, epg, menu, volume_up, digit_7, ...) or a raw numeric key code.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: How many times to send the key.
